name: Mesu Nie Gari ~Ingyaku no Arcade-gai
original_name: 牝贄狩～淫虐のアーケード街
source:
The main character runs a security company in a certain local city.
His hobby, and his main job, is to sell the abducted women to those who are interested in them.
The place where the women are hunted is a mall in the corner of a busy downtown area.

There, there will always be a lot of people, and it doesn't matter who disappears.
Today again, he and his subordinates attack women in the hunting grounds of the downtown area and turn them into "commodities."

Who will be the prey this time?
translation:
主人公在某座地方城市经营一家保安公司。
他的兴趣，也是主要工作，就是把绑架来的女性卖给对她们感兴趣的人。
猎捕女性的地点，是繁华市区一角的购物中心。

那里总是人来人往，谁消失了都不会有人在意。
今天，他和手下再次袭击市中心的猎场，将女性变成“商品”。

这次的猎物会是谁？
